June 29, 2024

India Clinch T20 World Cup in Thrilling Barbados Final

By Feroz Khan in Bridgetown | Published June 29, 2024

India ended an 11-year wait for an ICC global trophy with an exhilarating seven-run victory over South Africa in the Men's T20 World Cup final at Kensington Oval.

Virat Kohli, who had struggled for fluency throughout the Caribbean leg of the tournament, delivered when his country needed him most, crafting a calculated 76 off 59 balls to anchor India to a formidable total of 176 for 7.

South Africa appeared poised for their maiden World Cup triumph when Heinrich Klaasen launched a ferocious assault, reducing the equation to 30 runs required from 30 deliveries with six wickets in hand.

However, Jasprit Bumrah and Hardik Pandya turned the tide in the death overs with ice-cold execution under extreme pressure. Bumrah conceded just six runs across his final two overs, bamboozling Marco Jansen with an unplayable in-cutter.

In the dramatic final over, Hardik Pandya defended 16 runs, aided by an iconic boundary catch from Suryakumar Yadav on the long-off ropes to dismiss the dangerous David Miller on the very first delivery.
